articles.title: Domain account password reset (self-service)
articles.resolution: Go to https://sso.company.com/reset, verify your identity via MFA and set a new password. It takes effect immediately for Windows, VPN and email.

articles.title: Privileged / admin account password reset
articles.resolution: REQUIRES SECURITY APPROVAL. The agent prepared a request and handed it to the on-call administrator.

articles.title: VPN setup from laptop (AnyConnect)
articles.resolution: Open Cisco Secure Client → select the 'Company-VPN' profile → sign in with domain SSO + MFA. If the profile is missing, install it from Company Portal.

articles.title: VPN keeps disconnecting
articles.resolution: 1) Disable Wi-Fi adapter power saving. 2) Update the client. 3) Switch the protocol to IKEv2. 4) If it persists, collect logs (Help → Diagnostics) and open an L2 ticket.

articles.title: Install software from the catalog (self-service)
articles.resolution: Open Company Portal → Apps → find the app → Install. It installs under your own rights, no admin password needed.

articles.title: Install software outside the catalog (needs approval)
articles.resolution: REQUIRES APPROVAL. The agent created a request with justification and handed it to the IT/security lead for sign-off.

articles.title: Printer not printing / offline
articles.resolution: 1) Check the status in Printers & Scanners → 'Open queue'. 2) Clear stuck jobs. 3) Restart the Print Spooler. 4) Reinstall the driver from Company Portal.

articles.title: Access to a network folder / SharePoint
articles.resolution: REQUIRES RESOURCE OWNER APPROVAL. The agent identified the owner, prepared the request and sent it for approval.

articles.title: Account locked out (non-privileged)
articles.resolution: The account unlocks automatically after 15 minutes, or via the self-service portal sso.company.com/unlock with MFA confirmation.

articles.title: MFA / OTP not arriving or phone lost
articles.resolution: REQUIRES IDENTITY VERIFICATION. The agent started a check via the manager/HR and handed it to security.

articles.title: Slow Wi-Fi / internet
articles.resolution: 1) Check the channel load on speedtest. 2) Switch to the 5 GHz SSID. 3) Update the Wi-Fi driver. 4) If several employees are affected, raise an L2 ticket (infrastructure).

articles.title: New laptop / hardware replacement
articles.resolution: REQUIRES BUDGET APPROVAL. The agent created a standard procurement request and handed it to purchasing/the manager.

articles.title: Phone / mobile email setup
articles.resolution: Install Outlook Mobile from the App Store / Google Play, sign in with your domain account + MFA, and allow profile management (Intune Company Portal).

articles.title: Software license request (needs budget)
articles.resolution: REQUIRES BUDGET APPROVAL. The agent checked for free licenses and, if none, created a procurement request.

articles.title: IT onboarding of a new employee
articles.resolution: REQUIRES MANUAL PROCESSING. The agent started the onboarding checklist and assigned owners per system.

articles.title: Teams / Outlook won't start
articles.resolution: 1) Sign out and back in. 2) Clear the cache (%appdata%/Microsoft/Teams). 3) Update the app. 4) Reinstall from Company Portal.

articles.title: Low disk space
articles.resolution: Run Disk Cleanup, clear Downloads/Temp, remove old Teams profiles. If you need more than 20 GB, raise a quota extension request.

articles.title: Data restore from backup
articles.resolution: REQUIRES APPROVAL. The agent checked for snapshots, prepared the request and handed it to the backup team.

articles.title: Suspected phishing / security incident
articles.resolution: CRITICAL. Immediate escalation to security/SoC. The agent isolated the case, collected metadata and sent a 'do not click' instruction.

articles.title: External monitor / docking station not detected
articles.resolution: 1) Reconnect the dock. 2) Update the dock firmware from Company Portal. 3) Win+P → Extend. 4) Check the cable/port.
